rationale: About readiness/update status is role-independent, non-Chat, non-Pilot, read-only, and has no completed runtime result; exercise warm/reload identity and only outcomes the current browser can honestly produce.
acceptance_gaps: All T70-T72 remain unverified; browser API unavailable and update available/no-update/throttled/error dimensions need explicit observed evidence or honest applicability limits.
constraints: Use exact fresh build receipt and verify installed extension ID/path/version before UI.
Do not claim a simulated update is installed; don't force unavailable APIs by changing product state.

For optional-permission denial, only count denial if Chrome actually presents the prompt from a confirmed absent permission; a silently granted/already-held permission proves grant/current state only. Remove it first and use a clean permission decision context if needed; no prompt means denial remains unverified.
open_questions: Can the current authorized browser session exercise T70-T72 across guest/member/admin without changing authentication, and which update outcomes does Chrome expose?
